selection: Lowest-volume G11 support satisfying every journal displacement and mesh screen; no automatic promotion when none passes.
datum: Relative journal-centre translation and axis rotation to the cylinder/head seating datum; report rigid-body registration separately.
required_inputs_not_qualified: engine-side head restraints and head fastener preload
carrier and cap screw grades, engagement, preload and tightening scatter
shaft retention and bearing/contact definitions including the 0.040 mm nominal radial gap
contact pairs, friction and separation behaviour
alloy and process-specific elastic and thermal properties versus temperature
correlated temperature field and operating load cycle
optimistic_linked_case_policy: May be separately labelled only after explicit mating-face and load-transfer definitions. Never bridge the nominal shaft gap by enlarging solids or report linked-interface motion as contact validation.
